verdict.rationale: Column's own docs say customers can issue and deposit checks through its APIs, which covers the core of programmatic check issuance and deposit. The pack has only that one line, and a Column engineer said checks were in beta at launch. Image capture for deposits is not described anywhere. Missing for 10: documented check-deposit image capture, detailed issuance/deposit API specifics (e.g., printing/mailing, status lifecycle), evidence of general availability beyond the beta mention, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, checks still work — programmatic check issuance and check deposit with image capture, because real businesses still receive and send paper

citations.quote: Column provides customers the ability to issue and deposit checks through our APIs.
